snippet.title: City of Voices demo launch trailer
snippet.description:
Co-developed by one of the writers and designers of The Rise of the Golden Idol, City of Voices is a short Golden Idol-like deduction game about a young girl who is catapulted from her suburban life into the mysterious world of the ancient Maya. Investigate a series of moments frozen in time. Examine clues and solve puzzles to uncover a story full of twists and turns. 

Play the demo and wishlist the full game at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3342470/City_of_Voices/
